t0_commit_message:
chore: commit working-tree codebase (non-.md, non-test) for full-repo audit

This commit stages 4,128 files from the working tree so the user can audit
the full repo state and identify gaps or hardening needs.

Scope of this commit:
- Production source code (lib/, scripts/, tools/, configs, mix.exs, etc.)
- Root configuration dotfiles (.coveragerc, .dockerignore, .lingmaignore)
- All untracked working-tree files (4,801 enumerated) minus exclusions

Explicitly excluded (per user instruction):
- All *.md documentation files (left in working tree for separate review)
- All test files (*_test.exs, *_test.ex, test_/, tests/, conftest.py, test_*.py)
- System/build dirs (_build/, deps/, node_modules/, __pycache__/, .pytest_cache/, target/, .bolt/, .idea/, .vs/, .gradle/, .mvn/, dist/)
- Unreadable/garbage dirs (..../, .agents/, .continue/, .devcontainer/, .github/, .hypothesis/, .kilo/, .kilocode/, .kiro/, .qoder/, .qwen/, .sixth/, .vscode/, c:Users*/)
- Volatile/runtime dirs (logs/, scratch/, tmp/, runs/)
- Tiannara subproject apps (tiannara-desktop, tiannara_api, tiannara_gui, tiannara_internal_dashboard, tiannara_mobile, tiannara_observatory, tiannara_pros, tiannara_runtime, tiannara_saas, tiannara_core)
- Secrets/config: .env, .env.production, .env.local
- Lock files: package-lock.json, yarn.lock, mix.lock, Cargo.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, Gemfile.lock, composer.lock, pubspec.lock
- Runtime artifacts: *.db, *.dump, erl_crash.dump, benchmark output logs

Project .gitignore (respected):
- The project has an aggressive .gitignore that excludes *.txt, *.log, tests/,
  test_*, tiiannara_gui/, tiiannara_internal_dashboard/, tiiannara_mobile/,
  and several mangled path entries. These exclusions are preserved.

Files force-added (overriding project .gitignore or local exclude):
- .coveragerc, .dockerignore, .lingmaignore (3 root dotfiles deemed important
  for audit). These were excluded by the project .gitignore or by the
  local .git/info/exclude list added during this prep; they are added with
  `git add -f` to make the audit complete.

A working-tree file EXCLUDED_FILES_REPORT.md (uncommitted) lists all 673
files from the working tree that were NOT staged, categorized by reason
(.gitignore, already-tracked-unchanged, test files, runtime artifacts,
garbage dirs). This is left in the working tree (not committed) because
the user requested no .md files in this commit.

This is a large bulk commit intended for repository-state audit only.
No code is intentionally modified beyond staging.
